basic_info.description: Experience the best of San Francisco living at 722 Naples Street charming home in the heart of the Excelsior that offers space, charm, and flexibility. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms and two bathrooms, all complemented by soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and classic architectural details like elegant moldings. The kitchen features ample cabinet storage, a dining area with access to the backyard, creating a perfect indoor-outdoor flow. The bright living room is the perfect space to unwind, filled with warm light and timeless character. Downstairs offers incredible versatility with a one-bedroom suite, one bathroom, a kitchenette, office space, and a private entrance ideal for extended family, guests, or creative use as a home office or rental. Step outside to a sunny, and spacious backyard ready for your dream garden, entertaining space, or outdoor oasis. The home also includes a one-car garage with automatic opener. Just two blocks from McLaren Park, you will have easy access to miles of hiking trails, dog runs, a serene lake, and more. Plus, you're only a block from public transportation and close to local shopping and amenities. This is a special opportunity to enjoy comfort, charm, and versatility in one of San Franciscos most connected neighborhoods.
